_comment: Frozen tolerances of validation protocol v2 (references/validation_protocol.md): absolute unless the key ends with _rel. Rule: tolerance = max(3 x calibration range over the 8 calibration runs (references/calibration.json), physical floor). Applied to ONE run vs the frozen reference (itself one calibration run) and, for N > 1, to the N-rank run vs the same build's 1-rank run. n = 8 calibration runs: an empirical range rule, not a 3-sigma guarantee.
